ceu: ✦ The conjunction between the Sun and Venus

t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
From {H:1818092064000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
s.d: Say a prayer or set an intention for your path.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
From {H:1818092064000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on home and family. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
From {H:1818092064000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
From {H:1818092064000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on your money and what you value. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
From {H:1818092064000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on your image and your personal energy. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
From {H:1818092064000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on rest and your inner life. This is where your strength lies today.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
From {H:1818092064000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to home and family.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on friends and plans for the future. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
From {H:1818092064000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on your career and your goals. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
From {H:1818092064000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
From {H:1818092064000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
From {H:1818092064000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on relationships and partnerships. There is more intensity than usual, so take it easy.
s.d: Join a group or a conversation about a subject you enjoy.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
From {H:1818092064000}, the Moon moves into {S:9} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.
The Sun and Venus are together in {S:4}: willpower and visibility, affection and harmony, all focused on routine, daily work and health. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Show your work: people who do not show up are not remembered.
